scripts.compile: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --outfile=.electron/main.js --external electron --external electron-updater && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=.electron/preload.cjs --external electron
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../frontend build && bun run compile && electron-builder
scripts.build:linux-windows: bun run --cwd ../frontend build && bun run compile && electron-builder --linux --win --x64 --config.extraMetadata.version=${DESKTOP_VERSION:-0.1.1-dev.0} --publish never
scripts.build:macos: bun run --cwd ../frontend build && bun run compile && electron-builder --mac --config.extraMetadata.version=${DESKTOP_VERSION:-0.1.1-dev.0} --publish never
scripts.pack: bun run --cwd ../frontend build && bun run compile && electron-builder --dir
